name: shidur-firebase
description: Shidur's Firebase project: Firestore rules, the approval pages, and the emulator tests (ADR-059). The Functions are in functions/.

scripts.emulated: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-shidur --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:emulated"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix functions test
